description: List earlier grid runs (newest first, at most 50): run_id, the question (prompt), when it last changed, and how it ran (model, tool_call_budget: 0 = classic, -1 = agentic until the row's context is full, > 0 = agentic with at most that many searches per row; template, context_mode; null for old runs). Read a run's table with grid_results.
name: list_grid_runs
